name: list_connections
description: List all available database connections

name: get_connection_info
description: Get detailed information about a specific database connection

connectionId.description: The ID or name of the database connection

name: execute_query
description: Execute a SQL query on a specific database connection (read-only queries)

connectionId.description: The ID or name of the database connection to use

query.description: The SQL query to execute (SELECT statements only)

maxRows.description: Maximum number of rows to return (default: 1000)

database.description: Optional database on the same server; reuses saved credentials and settings

name: write_query
description: Execute INSERT, UPDATE, or DELETE queries on a specific database connection

connectionId.description: The ID or name of the database connection to use

query.description: The SQL query to execute (INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE)

name: create_table
description: Create new tables in the database

connectionId.description: The ID or name of the database connection

name: alter_table
description: Modify existing table schema (add columns, rename tables, etc.)

connectionId.description: The ID or name of the database connection

name: drop_table
description: Remove a table from the database with safety confirmation

connectionId.description: The ID or name of the database connection

tableName.description: Name of the table to drop

name: get_table_schema
description: Get schema information for a specific table

connectionId.description: The ID or name of the database connection

tableName.description: The name of the table to describe

database.description: Optional database on the same server; reuses saved credentials and settings

name: export_data
description: Export query results to various formats (CSV, JSON, etc.)

connectionId.description: The ID or name of the database connection

query.description: The SQL query to execute for export (SELECT only)

maxRows.description: Maximum number of rows to export

database.description: Optional database on the same server; reuses saved credentials and settings

name: test_connection
description: Test connectivity to a database connection

connectionId.description: The ID or name of the database connection to test

database.description: Optional database on the same server; reuses saved credentials and settings

name: get_database_stats
description: Get statistics and information about a database

connectionId.description: The ID or name of the database connection

database.description: Optional database on the same server; reuses saved credentials and settings

name: list_tables
description: List all tables in a database

connectionId.description: The ID or name of the database connection

schema.description: Specific schema to list tables from (optional)

database.description: Optional database on the same server; reuses saved credentials and settings

name: append_insight
description: Add a business insight or analysis note to the memo

insight.description: The business insight or analysis note to store

connection.description: Optional connection ID to associate with this insight

tags.description: Optional tags to categorize the insight

name: list_insights
description: List all stored business insights and analysis notes

name: begin_transaction
description: Start a new database transaction

connectionId.description: The ID or name of the database connection

name: commit_transaction
description: Commit an active transaction

transactionId.description: The transaction ID returned by begin_transaction

name: rollback_transaction
description: Rollback an active transaction

transactionId.description: The transaction ID returned by begin_transaction

name: execute_in_transaction
description: Execute a query within an active transaction

transactionId.description: The transaction ID returned by begin_transaction

name: explain_query
description: Get the execution plan for a SQL query

connectionId.description: The ID or name of the database connection

analyze.description: Run EXPLAIN ANALYZE for actual execution stats

format.description: Output format for the execution plan

database.description: Optional database on the same server; reuses saved credentials and settings

name: compare_schemas
description: Compare schemas between two database connections

sourceConnectionId.description: The source connection ID to compare from

targetConnectionId.description: The target connection ID to compare to

name: get_pool_stats
description: Get connection pool statistics for a connection

connectionId.description: The ID or name of the database connection

database.description: Optional database on the same server; reuses saved credentials and settings

name: list_databases
description: List databases accessible through a saved PostgreSQL, MySQL/MariaDB, or SQL Server connection
